The main takeaway from our work is that
the spin-flipped channel acts as a dephaser in the absence of any in-elastic scattering.
the dephasing in mesoscopic rings can be caused by a single spin-flip scattering and not necessarily by inelastic scattering.
the spin-conductance is a better measure of dephasing in a mesoscopic conductor.
